name: Vendor-Specific Sequence Check
description: Validates that a text field (e.g. ScanningSequence, SequenceVariant) contains a vendor-specific required value (Siemens / GE / Philips). Use 'A+B' to require all values, 'A|B' to require any. Leave a vendor blank to skip it.

testCases.name: Vendor without a configured value is not checked
A+B fails when one value missing

parameterDefinitions.name: label
parameterDefinitions.label: Value label
parameterDefinitions.description: Human-readable name of the checked value, used in messages

parameterDefinitions.name: siemens_contains
parameterDefinitions.label: Siemens must contain
parameterDefinitions.description: Required value(s): 'A+B' = must contain all, 'A|B' = must contain any

parameterDefinitions.name: ge_contains
parameterDefinitions.label: GE must contain
parameterDefinitions.description: Required value(s): 'A+B' = must contain all, 'A|B' = must contain any

parameterDefinitions.description: Required value(s): 'A+B' = must contain all, 'A|B' = must contain any
